reminders: Separate organic and inorganic waste before collection.
Keep waste ready before the scheduled time. Do not leave it on the roadside.

learn.title: Why separate waste?
learn.body: Kitchen waste turns into compost when kept apart. Dry plastic and paper can be recycled, which means less goes to the landfill.

learn.title: What is organic waste?
learn.body: Food scraps, vegetable peels, leaves and flowers.

learn.title: What is recyclable?
learn.body: Clean paper, cardboard, plastic bottles, glass and metal cans.

learn.title: What should never be mixed?
learn.body: Batteries, electronics and medicines. Keep them out of the regular bin.
